method: Every G1 gate re-measured. Node probes of JointModel written for this round (scripts/jm-*.mjs): a 0.1 deg grid of the shoulder's rotation neutral over every allowed direction, unrestricted random walks over the whole rotation group, great circles through the overhead point, full azimuth circles at 100-179.9 deg elevation, 40 deg near-limit lines, an independent brute force with a different boundary parametrisation (chart polar angle) and an own inside test. Browser probes (scripts/g1v2-live.mjs, g1v2-sd.mjs) on the live scene: per-vertex depth below the drawn resting surfaces by an own vertical ray cast of the resting meshes' triangles (no footprint list), every way out checked (never down, side exits lead into free space), 60,000 and 200,000 random points in and around the table, the app's jointClampSweep plus a JointModel built in the page on the live skeleton. The round-1 verifier's independent probe (verify/scripts/g1-probe.mjs) re-run in Chrome and WebKit at both sizes. Scripts carry absolute paths of this machine.

V1.measured: Hanging-arm flexion and abduction 170->190 and 150->210 deg in 0.25 deg steps: 0 jumps on the live rig (Chrome and WebKit, both sizes; before: 120 and 110 deg), max output step 0.25 deg (flexion) and 0.566 deg (abduction), output held 0.32-0.46 deg from overhead. Rotation neutral continuous over every allowed direction (0.1 deg grid, elevation 60-180 deg, 1,873,268 allowed points per shoulder): largest change 0.28 deg between neighbours 0.1 deg apart; the blend's wrap stays at least 54.2 deg away from the allowed region. Humeral rotation range 160 deg at every elevation 90-180 deg, one tie per full turn (live rig, 7 elevations per shoulder). No output jump for any input within 25 deg of any limit: 0 in 15.2 million node steps (walks, great circles, azimuth circles, near-limit lines) and 2.67 million live-rig steps per browser run.

Signed distance max 51.81 mm (was 37.47), p95 36.58 mm; 0 downward normals on skin; 320 side exits, 0 of them into another solid. Identical in Chrome and WebKit at 1440x900 and 560x890. 60,000 random points: 10,533 inside a resting column, 0 of them read outside; 1-Lipschitz (worst ratio 0.99995).

nonBlocking: JointModel near the shoulder's overhead apex, deep beyond the limit: the implementer's numbers are optimistic. Output jumps of 2.1-4.5 deg in one 0.1 deg input step start 27.0 deg (live rig) / 28.3 deg (node) beyond the limit, not 36.5 deg (that figure counts only jumps of >= 5 deg); for inputs 18-25 deg beyond, steps under 2 deg move up to 14.2x faster than the input (report: up to 9x). Within 10 deg the worst is 3.93x on great circles through overhead (report: 3.69x). tests/joint-model.test.js:280 says 26.7 deg, the report 36.5 deg. G3 must keep clamp inputs within about 15 deg of the limit (its per-second caps) or rate-limit the clamp output.

Far beyond the shoulder limit the ties are spread, not single: a pure flexion sweep 90->270 deg makes 42 consecutive output steps of 2-20 deg between 233.5 and 243.75 deg (56-110 deg beyond), abduction 44 between 228.5 and 239.25 deg (probe/jm-shoulder-sweep-90-270.json).

SupportSurface stackBottom is the lowest bottom of ANY box whose footprint overlaps, even a small fitting: both arm-board columns reach down to 0.782 (L/R_armboard_joint) although the plate's underside is at 0.8425, so 60 mm of free space under each arm board reads as solid; the back and seat pad columns reach 0.7275 over their full +-0.2825 m width from central_carrier (+-0.22 m). Not reached at rest; a hand passing under an arm board in G3 would be pushed out of a solid that is not drawn.

Non-resting boxes keep the plain box distance, so their way out can still point down: 1,852 of 200,000 random points around the table, 95 of them within the reach of skin (<= 80 mm under a resting top, <= 60 mm outside its footprint), all in radiolucent_deck or a rail mount near the arm-board/table-edge junction. 0 for skin at rest. G3 should not push a sample out through the bottom of the deck.

sd under-reads sinking near pad edges by design: 320 vertices exit through a pad side, 200 of them more than 10 mm shallower than their depth below the top; all 320 lead into free space. G2 'no sinking' gates must use belowTop*, as the implementer says.

The coarse-boundary cache is keyed by the four semi-axes, so knee-coupled limits (hip, ankle) rebuild it on every call when the knee moves: 14-16 us per clamp against 3-4 us with fixed limits (probe/jm-clamp-cost.json). Within budget, worth a quantised key in G3/G4.
Idempotence is not exact for every seed: 1 of 20,000 random shoulder.R rotations still reports changed on a second clamp (it moves 4.2e-6 deg); harmless for write discipline (1e-5 rad).
The sitting pose reads 6 HARD (implementer's open issue 2): G3/G4 must not clamp authored poses or the pose tween.
